integrity: All mathematical claims here are new work on the three-row model. Previously known general eventual period-two behavior, two-row calculations and isolated four-by-four counts are excluded from the novelty claim. The symbolic input and raw executable verification files are included. No independent validation or historical uniqueness certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The uniform iterate identities were proved through reproducible quantifier-free linear-integer unsatisfiability checks (Z3); no separately checked hand-elimination certificate is supplied. The first-entry census is an exact finite multinomial sum rather than simplified closed-form coefficients. It applies only to the specified 3-row rook graph, synchronous majority and tie retention; an independently conducted audit has not occurred. The 1980 foundational source has only a year-verified release date.
title: Sharp parity-dependent majority relaxation on three-row rook graphs
